                for dr,dc in shape: g[r+dr][c+dc]=7
    return g

def transform(grid):
    """Copy the shape marked by 7s onto every matching all-zero footprint."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 7]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points}
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if all(0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w and grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0
                   for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = 7
    return out
PY
